40006698.author: पदार्थः
40006698.content: सुतीक्ष्णेन by Sutikshna, अभ्यनुज्ञातम् permitted, प्रस्थितम् to leave, भर्तारम् husband, रघुनन्दनम् delight of the Raghus, हृद्यया heartily, स्निग्धया affectionately, वाचा with words, इदम् these, अब्रवीत् said.

40006698.author: Translation
40006698.content: While Rama was leaving with the permission of Sutikshna, Sita spoke these warm, affectionate words to her husband:

40006699.author: पदार्थः
40006699.content: महान् great, अयं धर्मः this righteous path, सुसूक्ष्मेण in a subtle, विधिना means, प्राप्यते  is obtained, अयम् this, कामजात् born of desire, व्यसनात् by addiction, निवृत्तेन by that which is averted, इह here, शक्यः not possible.

40006699.author: Translation
40006699.content: This great path of dharma you are following now can be attained only through subtle means by one free from addiction born of passion.

40006700.author: पदार्थः
40006700.content: अत्र here (in this context), कामजानि born out of lust, व्यसनानि vices, त्रीण्येव three only, उत indeed, भवन्ति are there, मिथ्यावाक्यम् speaking untruth, परमकम् greatest of all, परदाराभिगमनम् have sexual relation with others' wives विना वैरम् without enmity, रौद्रता violent acts, उभौ both, तस्मात् therefore, गुरुतरौ are of serious nature.

40006700.author: Translation
40006700.content: There are three kinds of vices born out of lust. First, speaking untruth, second, having sexual relation with others' wives and third, resorting to violence with no enmity. The later two vices are of serious nature.

40006701.author: पदार्थः
40006701.content: राघव Rama, मिथ्यावाक्यम्  lie, ते to  you, न भूतम् never practised, न भविष्यति nor in future, धर्मनाशनम् destroying the character, परेषाम् other's, स्त्रीणाम् women, अभिलषणम् such desire, कुतः how can it come to you.

40006701.author: Translation
40006701.content: O Rama you never spoke untruth in the past nor will you speak in future. How can there be any desire in you to destroy the virtue of others' wives ?

40006702.author: पदार्थः
40006702.content: मनुष्येन्द्र O Indra among men, तव to you, एतत् now, नास्ति does not exist, ते to you, कदाचन at any time, न अभूत् च did not happen earlier, राम Rama, तथा like that, मनस्यपि even in your mind, क्वचित् indeed at any time, न विद्यते does not exist.

40006702.author: Translation
40006702.content: O Rama, lord among men, you hadn't it (lust for other women) in the past. You havn't it now. Never does it exist even in your mind.

40006703.author: पदार्थः
40006703.content: नृपात्मज O prince , त्वम् you, नित्यमेव always, स्वदारनिरतः ever attached to your wife, धर्मिष्ठः righteous, सत्यसन्धश्च adherent to truth, पितुः father, निर्देशकारकः obedient.

40006703.author: Translation
40006703.content: O prince, you are always faithful to your wife. You are righteous, truthful and obedient to your father's orders.

40006704.author: पदार्थः
40006704.content: सत्यसन्ध truthful, महाभाग reverend, श्रीमन् powerful one, लक्ष्मणपूर्वज one born before Lakshmana (Rama), त्वयि in you, धर्मश्च righteousness, सत्यं च truth, त्वयि in you, सर्वम् all, प्रतिष्ठितम् are wellestablished.

40006704.author: Translation
40006704.content: O Rama, you are truthful, honourable, powerful. O elder brother of Lakshmana, in you is established truth and righteousness.

40006705.author: पदार्थः
40006705.content: महाबाहो longarmed, तत् that, सर्वम् all, जितेन्द्रियैः having conquered the senses, धर्तुम् to hold, शक्यम् possible, शुभदर्शन pleasing to look at, तव वश्येन्द्रियत्वम् your ability to control the senses, जानामि I know.

40006705.author: Translation
40006705.content: O longarmed one, to contain all this is only possible for those who have conquered the senses. O handsome one, I know your ability to control the senses.

40006706.author: पदार्थः
40006706.content: निर्वैरम् without enmity, यत् as such, इदम् this, रौद्रम् wrath, परप्राणाभिहिंसनम् showing violence on other beings, मोहात् out of delusion, क्रियते is carried out, तत् that, तृतीयम् third, ते you, समुपस्थितम्  befallen.

40006706.author: Translation
40006706.content: (But) you are a victim to the third (vice born of lust) i.e. showing violence without cause for enmity

40006707.author: पदार्थः
40006707.content: वीर O valiant one , दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम् those residing in Dandaka forest, ऋषीणाम् of sages, रक्षणार्थाय to protect them, संयति in battle, रक्षसाम् with demons, वधः killing, त्वया by you, प्रतिज्ञात: is promised.

40006707.author: Translation
40006707.content: O valiant one, you have promised to kill the demons in the battle, in order to protect the sages residing in the Dandaka forest.

40006708.author: पदार्थः
40006708.content: एतन्निमित्तम् for this reason, त्वम् you, धृतबाणशरासनः wielding bow and arrows, भ्रात्रा सह with brother, दण्डकाः Dandaka forest, इति by name, विश्रुतम् wellknown, वनम् forest, प्रस्थितः entered.

40006708.author: Translation
40006708.content: It is only on account of this that you entered the wellknown Dandaka forest with your brother wielding bow and arrows.

40006709.author: पदार्थः
40006709.content: ततः therefore, प्रस्थितम् present, त्वाम् you, दृष्ट्वा seeing, मम to me, मनः mind, चिन्ताकुलम् is worried, त्वद्वृत्तम् your stand, चिन्तयन्त्याः while I reflect, हितम् salutary, निश्रेयसम् final benefit, भवेत् वै it is wished.

40006709.author: Translation
40006709.content: I am, therefore, worried in my mind when I see you here and think of your wellbeing. I wish your ultimate good. [The next two lines appear, more or less, a repetition. So omitted : Editor]

40006710.author: पदार्थः
40006710.content: वीर O brave Rama, दण्डकान् प्रति to Dandakaranyam, गमनम् going, मे to me, न रोचते not to my liking, तत्र there, कारणम् reason, वक्ष्यामि I shall tell, मम वदन्त्याः my saying so, श्रूयताम् please listen.

40006710.author: Translation
40006710.content: O brave Rama, I do not like your going to Dandaka forest. I shall tell you the reason. Do listen.

40006711.author: पदार्थः
40006711.content: वीर O brave Rama, दण्डकान् प्रति to Dandakaranyam, गमनम् going, मे to me, न रोचते not to my liking, तत्र there, कारणम् reason, वक्ष्यामि I shall tell, मम वदन्त्याः my saying so, श्रूयताम् please listen.

40006711.author: Translation
40006711.content: O brave Rama, I do not like your going to Dandaka forest. I shall tell you the reason. Do listen.

40006712.author: पदार्थः
40006712.content: बाणधनुष्पाणिः holding bow and arrows, त्वम् you, भ्रात्रा सह with your brother, वनम् to the forest, गतः you are gone, सर्वान् all, वनचरान् forestrangers दृष्ट्वा seeing, शरव्ययम् release of arrows, कच्चित् कुर्यात् you may resort to.

40006712.author: Translation
40006712.content: Of course, you will go to the forest with your brother, holding the bow and arrows. Release the arrows when you see the forestrangers.

40006713.author: पदार्थः
40006713.content: क्षत्रियाणाम् for Kshatriyas, समीपतः nearby, स्थितम् available, धनुः bow, हुताशस्य for a fire, इन्धनानि च is fuel also, भृशम् surely, तेजः lustre, बलम् strength, उच्छ्रयते increases.

40006713.author: Translation
40006713.content: A bow in the hand of a kshatriya is like fuel to fire. It surely swells his strength and his brilliance.

40006714.author: पदार्थः
40006714.content: महाबाहो mightyarmed, पुरा in the past, पुण्ये in a sacred, रतमृगद्विजे where animals and birds roamed, कस्मिंश्चित्  some, वने in a forest, सत्यवाक् one who speaks the truth, शुचिः pure, तपस्स्वी ascetic, अभवत् किल lived.

40006714.author: Translation
40006714.content: O mightyarmed one, there dwelt in the past an ascetic, noble and truthful in a sacred forest where animals and birds lived merrily together.

40006715.author: पदार्थः
40006715.content: अथ then, शचीपतिः husband of Sachi, इन्द्रः Indra, तस्यैव his only, तपसः penance, विघ्नम् obstruction, कर्तुम् to do, भटरूपधृत् in the guise of an attendant, खङ्गपाणिः sword in hand, आश्रमम् to the hermitage, आगच्छत् came.

40006715.author: Translation
40006715.content: Once Indra, husband of Sachi, came to his hermitage in the guise of an attendant, sword in hand, in order to hinder his penance.

40006716.author: पदार्थः
40006716.content: तदा then, तस्मिन् in that, आश्रमपदे at the hermitage, पुण्ये holy, तपसि in penance, तिष्ठतः practising, निशितः a sharp, उत्तमः best, सः खङ्ग: that sword, न्यासविधिना as a trust, दत्तः was deposited.

40006716.author: Translation
40006716.content: Then while the sage was practising penance at the hermitage, he gave him that excellent sword to be kept in trust.

40006717.author: पदार्थः
40006717.content: सः तु that sage, तत् that, शस्त्रम् weapon, अनुप्राप्य having received, आत्मनः his own, प्रत्ययम् trust, रक्षन् while keeping, न्यासरक्षणतत्परः always attentive in protecting that deposit, वने in the forest, विचरत्येव  went wandering.

40006717.author: Translation
40006717.content: Having received the weapon as a trust, the sage went wandering in the forest, always attentive in safeguarding the weapon.

40006718.author: पदार्थः
40006718.content: न्यासरक्षणतत्परः ever alert in protecting the trust, मूलानि च roots, फलानि च and fruits, यत्र wherever, गच्छति he goes, तं खङ्गं विना without that sword, न याति does not go,

40006718.author: Translation
40006718.content: Vigilant about protecting the sword deposited with him, the sage never moved without it even when he went gathering roots and fruits.

40006719.author: पदार्थः
40006719.content: नित्यम् always, शस्त्रम् weapon, परिवहन् while carrying, सः तपोधनः that sage, तपसि in penance, निश्चयम् his resolve, त्यक्त्वा after giving up, क्रमेण gradually, स्वाम् his, बुद्धिं intellect, रौद्रीम् fierce, चकार developed.

40006719.author: Translation
40006719.content: While the sage moved about holding the weapon, he gave up the practice of penance gradually and developed a violent mindset.

40006720.author: पदार्थः
40006720.content: ततः then, तस्य of that, शस्त्रस्य संवासात् in association with the weapon, रौद्रे in a violent mood, अभिरतः always involved, सः that, मुनिः sage, प्रमत्तः in excitement अधर्मकर्शितः dragged in unrighteous ways, नरकम् to hell, जगाम went.

40006720.author: Translation
40006720.content: By association with the sword, he developed a violent attitude. And in that habitual state of excitement he was dragged into unrighteous ways which (ultimately) took him to hell.

40006721.author: पदार्थः
40006721.content: पुरा in the past, एतत् that, शस्त्रसंयोगकारणम् owing to contact with the weapon, वृत्तम् this happened, शस्त्र संयोगः association with the weapon, अग्निसम्योगवत् like contact with fire हेतुः becomes a cause, उच्यते it is said, स्नेहाच्च out of love, बहुमानाच्च out of great respect, त्वाम् to you, स्मारये I am reminding, न शिक्षये I am not instructing you.

40006721.author: Translation
40006721.content: Contact with the weapon has led to this in the past. Like contact with fire, it leads man to destruction. I say this out of my love and reverence for you as a reminder and not as an instruction.

40006722.author: पदार्थः
40006722.content: पुरा in the past, एतत् that, शस्त्रसंयोगकारणम् owing to contact with the weapon, वृत्तम् this happened, शस्त्र संयोगः association with the weapon, अग्निसम्योगवत् like contact with fire हेतुः becomes a cause, उच्यते it is said, स्नेहाच्च out of love, बहुमानाच्च out of great respect, त्वाम् to you, स्मारये I am reminding, न शिक्षये I am not instructing you.

40006722.author: Translation
40006722.content: Contact with the weapon has led to this in the past. Like contact with fire, it leads man to destruction. I say this out of my love and reverence for you as a reminder and not as an instruction.

40006723.author: पदार्थः
40006723.content: गृहीतधनुषा by one holding a bow, त्वया by you, वैरं विना without animosity, दण्डकाश्रितान् those taking shelter in Dandaka, राक्षसान् demons, हन्तुम् to kill, सा बुद्धि: that thinking, कथञ्चन on any account, न कार्या should not be done, अपराधं विना without any offence, लोकान् the people, हन्तुम् to kill, न कामये not desirable.

40006723.author: Translation
40006723.content: While holding a bow, you should not have the intention to kill demons residing in Dandaka with no animosity against you. O valiant one  I do not desire that any one should be killed without incurring any offence.

40006724.author: पदार्थः
40006724.content: वनेषु in the forests, निरतात्मनाम् those practising selfcontrol, वीराणाम् for warriors, क्षत्रियाणाम् for kshatriyas, आर्तानाम् of the panicked, अभिरक्षणम् protection, एतावत् this much, धनुषा with a bow, कार्यम्  duty.

40006724.author: Translation
40006724.content: It is the duty of a kshatriya, a warrior to protect with his bow those who practise selfcontrol (penance) in the forest in a state of panic.

40006725.author: पदार्थः
40006725.content: क्वच शस्त्रं where is a weapon, क्व च वनं and where is a forest, क्व च क्षात्रं where is the duty of a kshatriya, तपः क्वच and where is penance, अस्माभि by us, इदं this, व्याविद्धम् is encroached, देशधर्मस्तु law of the locality पूज्यताम् may be honoured.

40006725.author: Translation
40006725.content: Where is the question of wielding a weapon and living in the forest, where is the life of a kshatriya and the life of penance? For us, this is an encroachment. Let the law of the land be honoured.

40006726.author: पदार्थः
40006726.content: आर्य Lord  तत् thus, शस्त्रसेवनात् serving the weapons बुद्धि: mind, कलुषा impure, जायते will be, पुनः again, गत्वा after going to, अयोध्यायाम् to Ayodhya, क्षत्रधर्मम् duty of a Kshatriya, चरिष्यसि you can practise.

40006726.author: Translation
40006726.content: Lord, when we handle the weapon, the mind gets vitiated. (Only) after returning to Ayodhya can you perform the duty of a kshatriya.

40006727.author: पदार्थः
40006727.content: त्वम् you, राज्यम् kingdom, परित्यज्य having given up, निरतः permanent, मुनिः an ascetic, भवेः you, यदि if, मम to me, श्वश्रूश्वशुरयोः to motherinlaw and fatherinlaw, अक्षया unlimited, प्रीतिः joy, भवेत् will be.

40006727.author: Translation
40006727.content: You would have been on unlimited source of joy to my fatherinlaw and motherinlaw had you permanently renounced the kingdom for the life of an ascetic.

40006728.author: पदार्थः
40006728.content: धर्मात् from righteous duty, अर्थः wealth, प्रभवति will arise, धर्मात् from righteousness, सुखम् happiness, प्रभवते will result, धर्मेण by righteous ways, सर्वम् everything, लभते is attained, इदं जगत् this world, धर्मसारम् the essence is dharma.

40006728.author: Translation
40006728.content: Righteousness brings wealth. Wealth brings happiness. Righteousness brings everything. In fact, the essence of the world is righteousness.

40006729.author: पदार्थः
40006729.content: निपुणैः by wisemen, आत्मानम् themselves, तैस्तै: by their various means, नियमैः by their discipline, प्रयत्नतः with effort, कर्शयित्वा after crushing, धर्मः righteousness, प्राप्यते is  attained, सुखात् from happiness, सुखम् joy, न लभ्यते will not be attained.

40006729.author: Translation
40006729.content: The wise earn dharma through getting their bodies emaciated by carefully adopting different means of discipline (selftorture). Happiness does not beget happiness.

40006730.author: पदार्थः
40006730.content: सौम्य O gentle one, नित्यम् always, शुचिमतिः with a pure mind (free from thoughts of punishing the innocent), तपोवने in this forest of ascetics, धर्मम् dharma, चर follow, त्रैलोक्यम् three worlds, सर्वम् अपि all put together, तुभ्यम् to you, तत्त्वतः in true spirit, विदितं हि is known indeed.

40006730.author: Translation
40006730.content: O gentle one you may move in this forest of ascetics with a pure mind. The true meaning behind everything in these three worlds is known to you, indeed.
